messages:
emily: Quick sync  co-host webinar with CloudArc + MiniBoards on Fri 11am PT. Need final speaker list, one-slide partner intros, demo runbook, and swag manifest by Wed EOD. Drive: https://drive.example.com/cloudarc-miniboards.
raj: Added. I'll own speaker outreach. Who's running the live demo?
olga: I can run the demo. Question: use quantized model for latency or high-accuracy float for better examples? Partners prefer snappy responses.
ben: Recommend q8-quant primary, v2-high as fallback. I'll prepare routing rule to failover to hosted if device health < 90%.
frank: I'll handle swag. Partners request small items only (stickers + postcard). EU customs prefer printed matterwe'll do postcards there.
calendar-bot: Reminder: Rehearsal scheduled Thu 09:30am PT in Zoom room "Partner Rehearse"  invites sent.
emily: Ship 5 kits (3 demo, 2 spares). Shipping folder updated with weights and HS code 8471. Please add pro forma invoice for EU.
olga: I'll run hardware preflight Mon 08:00am PT to repro a kernel mismatch. Will post results.
ben: AV checklist: monitor, HDMI->DP, cat6, power strip, USB mic. I'll bring an HDMI capture as streaming fallback.
raj: Can marketing get two co-branded headshots? Partners will try to send by Tue.
emily: Good. Sophie from marketing can compile slides. Final deck to Drive by Wed EOD.
ben: Fallback plan: if hardware fails, switch to hosted demo + prerecorded clip. I'll prep a 90s clip and put it in the folder.
olga: Partners confirmed they'll join rehearsal for screen share.
emily: Great  latest items: speaker list to Raj, deck to Sophie, swag to Frank, shipping manifest by Wed AM. Call out blockers here. :rocket:
